title: Jaded
description:
Play at Your Own Pace! 

Slow down time to evaluate the situation - then strike!

Or, dash your way through levels at supersonic speeds!

Fight or Flight?

Slash your way through enemies and boss fights- watch out, three hits and you’re dead!

Bind your foes together to take them out all at once!

Take in the Ambience.

Awaken deep in the heart of a cavern and embark on your quest to save a life. Traverse 350+ rooms as you venture across the island of Stosia. 

Keep Your (Singular) Eye Out...

Hunt to find all 51 secret butterflies hidden throughout your adventure!
description_short: A fast-paced platformer where you can slash, dash, and control time. Slow down the frenzy of combat and find the right moment to strike! Then, aim the 360-degree dash and zoom away at lightning speed! Master your abilities to maneuver around obstacles and vaporize foes before they can touch you.
